summary: Generic preparation from the presets. Ask the agent to research this exact model for model-specific menus.

steps.title: Install software updates first
steps.why: Updates fix bugs and sometimes reset privacy choices – update first, then go through the rest.
steps.how: Choose 'Scan for upgrade' and install anything found.

steps.title: Turn off viewing information (Samba TV / ACR)
steps.why: Vestel TVs ship with Samba TV, which recognises what is on screen to build an ad profile.
steps.how: Turn off 'Viewing information', 'Interactive TV' / Samba TV and similar consents. Menu names vary: follow what the TV shows.

steps.title: HbbTV: block tracking
steps.why: The red-button (HbbTV) service can track viewing even when you never open it.
steps.how: Set Do not track On, Cookies Off, Persistent storage Off, Block tracking sites On, and reset the Device ID. Turn HbbTV off completely if nobody uses the red button.

steps.title: Network standby
steps.why: Keeps the TV reachable (DIAL app launching, casting) while it is in standby.
steps.how: Turn it on if the menu exists; it uses a little more power in standby.

steps.title: HDMI-CEC for a streaming stick
steps.why: Needed if you add an Android / Google TV stick: one remote then controls TV power and volume.
steps.how: Turn CEC on (and 'CEC auto power on'). Only needed with a device on HDMI.

steps.title: Optional: add an Android / Google TV stick for the full workflow
steps.why: This TV can't be debloated or get new apps. A Google TV Streamer, Chromecast with Google TV or Fire TV Stick on HDMI gets everything (Kodi, SmartTube, Projectivy, screensaver, buttons).
steps.how: Plug it into an HDMI port, finish its setup, turn on Developer options › USB debugging, then + ADD TV in the control center.
